description: Architecture snapshot of the Er Gen Verse Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod — a Renegade Immortal (仙逆) novel adaptation. Captures all systems, data flows, and integration points for session continuity.

fourLayerArchitecture.description: Constitution Art XLII — four-layer separation of canon, authored geography, initial snapshot, and simulation delta.

layer0.name: Read-only JAR (Canon)
layer0.description: Immutable canon facts from the novel. 158 characters, 80 locations, 178 artifacts, 214 techniques. Never modified at runtime.

layer1.name: Authored Geography
layer1.description: Authored world blueprints — countries, settlements, mountain ranges, spirit veins. The stage is fixed; the simulation varies.

layer2.name: Initial Snapshot (WorldGraph)
layer2.description: CRON-137: WorldGraph IS Layer 2's runtime representation. Populated from Layer 0+1 at bootstrap. 630+ nodes, 500+ edges. Single integration point for all simulation systems.

layer3.name: Simulation Delta
layer3.description: Runtime changes write ONLY here. Player actions, beast harvests, weather damage — all journal through the facade → store → replay on reload.

worldGraph.description: CRON-137: The single integration point for all simulation systems.
worldGraph.bootstrap: GraphBootstrap.bootstrap() — called in Ergenverse() constructor after WangLinMasterRegistry.bootstrap()

graphBootstrap.description: Populates WorldGraph from RICanonicalDatabase. Creates nodes for all canon entities and edges from canon relationships.

edges.social: From CanonCharacter.relationships — love_interest→LOVES, family→FAMILY_OF, master→MENTORED_BY, enemy→ENEMY_OF, disciple→DISCIPLE_OF, rival→RIVALS, ally→ALLY_OF, friend→FAMILIAR_WITH
edges.ownership: From CanonArtifact.currentOwner — OWNS edge from owner NPC to artifact
edges.spatial: From CanonLocation.parentLocation — LOCATED_IN edge from child location to parent location

graphBootstrap.nameResolution: Case-insensitive name→entity maps built at bootstrap. CanonCharacter/CanonLocation relationships use NAMES, not IDs. Unresolved names logged as warnings, edge skipped.

graphQueryService.description: Wraps WorldGraph traversal into simulation-ready queries. The API consumers use — no raw edge traversal needed.

social.socialContacts(npcId): Direct social contacts (FAMILIAR_WITH, ALLY_OF, FAMILY_OF, MENTORED_BY, DAO_COMPANION, SWORN_SIBLING, SERVES, DISCIPLE_OF, SAVED, LOVES, RESPECTS)
social.socialNetwork(npcId, maxDepth): BFS walk of social edges — all reachable NPCs within maxDepth hops

spatial.whatExistsAt(locationId): Graph-backed WorldStateEngine Q1 — returns LocationEntry records

ownership.findOwner(entityId): The NPC that OWNS this entity (incoming OWNS edge)
ownership.ownedEntities(npcId): All entities owned by an NPC (outgoing OWNS edges)
ownership.whoOwns(entityId): Graph-backed WorldStateEngine Q2 — returns OwnershipInfo record

karmic.netKarmicBurden(npcId): Weighted sum: negative karma +1 per edge, positive karma -1 per edge
karmic.karmicConnections(npcId): All NPCs connected by karmic edges
karmic.whoWants(entityId): Graph-backed WorldStateEngine Q3 — NPCs with desire edges (KARMIC_DEBT, GRUDGE, VENGEANCE_OBLIGATION, HATES, ENEMY_OF)

threats.threatsNearSettlement(settlementId, maxD: BEAST nodes via LOCATED_IN subtree walk

information.whoKnowsAbout(entityId): Graph-backed WorldStateEngine Q4 — NPCs with WITNESSED or FAMILIAR_WITH edges

diagnostic.describeNode(nodeId): Human-readable summary: name, type, registry ID, edge counts

rumorNetwork.description: Rumors now propagate along social connections (FAMILIAR_WITH, ALLY_OF, etc.) instead of ActorRegistry.all() brute-force spatial proximity. Canon-faithful: xianxia cultivators communicate via jade slips, sound transmission, and sect networks across vast distances. Fallback to spatial brute-force for procedural NPCs not in the graph.

worldStateEngine.description: 6 query methods (queryWhatExists, queryWhoOwns, queryWhoWants, queryWhoKnows, queryWhyUntaken, queryNaturalNext) still iterate JSON subsystems. GraphQueryService provides graph-backed equivalents (whatExistsAt, whoOwns, whoWants, whoKnowsAbout) — next CRON should wire WorldStateEngine to call graph-first with JSON fallback.

actorMaterializer.description: materializeAroundPlayer() builds WorldSituation inline from SettlementThreatIndex.getSituationThreat() + OpportunityRegistry.getLiveOpportunitiesNear(). Next CRON should wire to GraphQueryService.threatsNearSettlement() + whatExistsAt().

cultivatorFlight.description: CRON-130 through CRON-136 — cultivator sword-flight (御剑飞行) system.

components.CultivatorFlightGoal: CRON-130: Foundation+ cultivators take flight when hostile mob >18 blocks away. 30s timeout, 8-block yield distance.
components.CultivatorFlightNavigator: CRON-133/135/136: Obstacle-aware velocity computation. Forward ray-cast (3 body heights) + upward ray-cast (3 tall-obstacle heights +3/+6/+9) + perpendicular dodge (3 height probes +1/+3/+6) + upward vault (standard 0.8D, tall 3.0D math-derived).
components.ride_sword ModelPart: CRON-132: Visible sword under cultivator's feet during flight. Metallic blade gradient painted to 23 textures.
components.qiSystem: CRON-134: EntityCultivator qi system. maxQi per realm (Foundation=100, Core=500, Nascent=2000, Soul+=10000). Flight costs 0.2 qi/tick. 10% activation gate, 5% abort gate. 1.0/sec regen when grounded.

cultivatorFlight.canonFidelity: Foundation Establishment (筑基) is the canonical minimum realm for flight (Baidu Baike-verified). Sword flight universally attested in 仙逆 as flying OVER mountains and around cliffs. NO fabricated chapter citations.

categories: Cultivation & Comprehension (14): COMPREHENDS, PRACTICES, TEACHES, INHERITED_FROM, ...
Social & Relationship (16): LOVES, HATES, FEARS, RESPECTS, RIVALS, SERVES, MENTORED_BY, BETRAYED, DAO_COMPANION, SWORN_SIBLING, FAMILY_OF, DISCIPLE_OF, ALLY_OF, ENEMY_OF, SAVED, FAMILIAR_WITH
Karma & Causality (11): KARMIC_DEBT, GRUDGE, GRATITUDE, KARMIC_THREAD, VENGEANCE_OBLIGATION, ...
Temporal & Historical (8): PRECEDES, CAUSED_BY, WITNESSED, PARTICIPATED_IN, ...
edgeTypes.missing: No HEARD edge type (referenced in RumorNetwork javadoc but not in EdgeType). Use FAMILIAR_WITH or WITNESSED as substitute.

nodeTypes.note: No SETTLEMENT type — use FACTION (deprecated SECT alias).

classes.CanonCharacter: final class with public fields: id, name, nameCn, type, peakRealm, affiliation, status, canonConfidence, firstAppearance, location, knownFacts, relationships, source
classes.CanonLocation: final class with public fields: id, name, nameCn, type, parentLocation, cosmologyLayer, worldLawTier, isSealed, sealedBy, spiritVeins, canonConfidence, associatedFactions, keyEvents, source
classes.CanonArtifact: final class with public fields: id, name, nameCn, type, category, currentOwner, abilities, origin, canonConfidence, source
classes.CanonTechnique: final class with public fields: id, name, nameCn, type, origin, effects, knownUsers, canonConfidence, source

ricanonicalDatabase.important: CanonCharacter/CanonLocation are final classes with public fields (NOT records). Relationships use NAMES, not IDs.
